Effort.description: A reasoning-effort level on the wire. Mirrors `bridge_core::delegation::Effort` variant for variant; a mirror test in bridge-core keeps the two from drifting.

ReviewerHarnessSettings.description: What the GitHub pull-request reviewer runs as on one harness. `None` falls through to the Reviewer model profile, then the harness default.

ReviewerSettings.description: Global settings for the subagent that reviews pull requests from the GitHub pane: per-harness model and effort, and the instructions it is given. One record, not per workspace — a reviewer's shape is a preference about the reviewer, not about the repository.

systemPrompt.description: Empty means Bridge's default review instructions. `{number}` expands to the pull request number.

description: The stored reviewer settings beside the default prompt they replace, so a client can show the text an empty prompt stands for.
